darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Item quantity
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-251: the order's units, its item rows' quantities summed (HotWax keeps one row per unit), read from the items by order id only when a rule reads it. Compared against Shopify itemQuantity (Item Sync: itemQuantity = itemQuantity); orderItemCount is a copy of Shopify's line count, not this.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Item quantity
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-251: units ordered (Order.subtotalLineItemsQuantity, the sum of line quantities as ordered, before refunds or removals). Compared against HotWax itemQuantity (Item Sync: itemQuantity = itemQuantity).
